title: Russian ballistic missile strike on central Kryvyi Rih kills two, wounds 60
summary: A Russian strike on the centre of Kryvyi Rih late on 20 November 2026 killed a seven-year-old boy and a 20-year-old woman and wounded 60 people, including six children, according to local officials. About 25 apartment buildings, a hospital, schools and businesses were damaged. The strike was part of continuing large-scale Russian attacks on Ukrainian cities and energy infrastructure.
impact_assessment: Observed: civilian deaths and injuries and damage to housing, a hospital and schools. Potential: continued strikes on civilian areas and energy infrastructure during winter.
priority_rationale: HIGH: confirmed lethal strike on a city centre as part of an ongoing interstate war; localised rather than a change in the war's overall course.
